reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Spec.OriginValues.mk
Paper notion: the constructor of the Lean structure encoding the origin-value conditions of
Assumption 2.2 (see the reading of Spec.OriginValues): from b(.,0,delta_0), sigma(.,0,delta_0),
h(.,0,.,delta_0), f(.,0,delta_0) in L^2(0,T) of their respective spaces, build the predicate.
Faithful iff its arguments are exactly the fields of a faithful OriginValues.

comparison.text:
Comparison: constructor Spec.OriginValues.mk vs locked reading.
Its four arguments are exactly the fields of OriginValues: MemLp of t ↦ C.b t 0 (P2.dirac 0),
C.σ, C.h, C.f, each in L² of Lebesgue on (0,T), and it returns OriginValues T C. Nothing extra,
nothing missing; its meaning is that of OriginValues.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices (open interval, as for OriginValues).

verdict.detail:
Representation choice: the four L²(0,T) memberships are stated on Lebesgue measure restricted to
the open interval (0,T) instead of [0,T]; the endpoints are Lebesgue-null, so MemLp on the two
restrictions is the same condition. Time ranges over ℝ in Coeffs, but only (0,T) enters.
